env_file_missing: No local configuration file found. Initialize one to get started.
reset_confirm: Reset all settings to default values? Your current settings will be overwritten.
no_packages: No configured packages found. Run 'Import Installed Packages' from the Dashboard.
export_config_desc: Create a zip with .env.local, packages, extensions and a snapshot of tracked dotfiles
init_from_zip_desc: Loads env, packages, extensions and dotfiles from configuration zip
packages_actions_desc: Update or remove packages manually through your system package manager.
dotfiles_intro: The app mirrors dotfiles.sh in manual mode: no cron is installed and nothing runs automatically in the background.
dotfiles_explainer_manual: Use SYNC_DIR as your shared folder, then run Init, Setup, Sync or Restore manually when needed.
dotfiles_explainer_zip: Export Configuration also snapshots tracked dotfiles into the ZIP. Initialize from zip restores them on the target machine.
dotfiles_explainer_drive_selected: Drive workflow selected: use SYNC_DIR as your shared folder. Once Setup creates symlinks, your cloud client synchronizes those files automatically.
dotfiles_explainer_zip_selected: ZIP workflow selected: use Export Configuration to create a snapshot, then Initialize from zip on the target machine.
dotfiles_drive_help: Best when you use OneDrive, Dropbox or Synology Drive and want a living shared source of truth. Once symlinks are created, the cloud client handles the automatic sync.
dotfiles_setup_recommended: Recommended next step: run Setup symlinks. After that, changes made in your home dotfiles are written directly into the shared drive folder.
dotfiles_zip_help: Best for backup, migration to another machine, or occasional restore without a shared drive.
dotfiles_confirm_init: Initialize the shared folder from the current local dotfiles?
dotfiles_confirm_setup: Create symlinks to the shared folder? Existing local files will be backed up as .backup.
dotfiles_confirm_restore: Restore dotfiles from the shared folder? Existing local files will be backed up as .backup.
shared_config_desc: Sync or restore packages.conf, extensions.conf and system settings through the shared drive, then initialize a machine directly from it.
shared_config_intro: Use the shared drive as the source of truth for packages.conf, extensions.conf and optional system_settings.conf. Sync publishes local changes; Restore pulls them back into the local runtime; Init from shared drive restores and then runs installation.
shared_action_sync: Sync local configs to shared drive
shared_confirm_restore: Restore shared configuration files locally? Existing local config files will be replaced.
shared_confirm_init: Initialize this machine from the shared drive now? Shared configs will be restored locally before installation runs.
